policyPage.heading: Terms, privacy, and event conditions.
policyPage.subtext: Please review the following before registering or attending Golden Falcon Night.

sections.title: Registration & Entry
sections.body: All attendees must register online and present a valid confirmation and photo identification at entry. Entry details and updates are sent to the email address provided at registration.

sections.title: Dress Code
sections.body: Business formal attire is required for all guests. Organizers reserve the right to review attire at the entrance in line with event guidelines.

sections.title: Ticket Transfers
sections.body: Tickets may be transferred to another attendee by updating the attendee information in your account prior to the event date.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Personal information collected during registration is used solely for event administration, communication, and safety, and is handled in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

sections.title: Media & Recording
sections.body: Photography and video recording will take place throughout the event for editorial and promotional purposes. By attending, guests consent to the possible use of their likeness in such materials.

sections.title: Cancellations & Refunds
sections.body: Cancellation and refund requests are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please contact the events team as early as possible for assistance.
